# MM-P3-L2-RR02-S3 Calibration checks - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-RR02

Scope
- Procedures for calibration verification of measurement and alignment systems on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02).  
- Verify machine capability to process rings up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.  
- Coordinate with operations and maintenance per SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04, SOP-P3-L2-05.

Tools
- Portable dial gauge and magnetic base.  
- Laser alignment tool.  
- Hand tools per maintenance kit for EQ-P3-L2-RR02.  
- Approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-930 (use for lubrication points during checks).  
- Calibration checklist form referenced in SOP-P3-L2-04.

Procedure
- Lock out and tag out equipment per SOP-P3-L2-03 before performing any adjustments.  
- Install measurement fixtures and apply form-fit reference ring appropriate for the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.  
- Using the laser alignment tool, verify headstock and mandrel concentricity relative to machine centerline. Record readings on the calibration checklist.  
- Use the portable dial gauge to confirm radial runout at critical axes. Document any deviation and mark components requiring adjustment.  
- Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-930 to specified lubrication points prior to functional verification per SOP-P3-L2-05.  
- After adjustments, re-run alignment and measurement checks and complete the checklist. Return machine to service only after verification is complete and tags are removed per SOP-P3-L2-03.

Acceptance criteria
- All measured alignment and runout values documented on the calibration checklist must be within manufacturer or process limits as specified in SOP-P3-L2-04.  
- Machine shall be cleared for production of rings up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm.  
- Lubrication performed with part number CFW-LUB-930 documented on the checklist.  
- Any out-of-tolerance conditions must be dispositioned per SOP-P3-L2-05 before release to production.
